description: Every screen and message the mashup shows, built from Borderlands 2's own dialog boxes and HUD messages (ui_utils), filled with Skyrim's text.

columns.opened_by: ref hooks.id or keybinds.id or another ui.id
columns.title: title text; {x} fields are filled at runtime
columns.in_game: yes once seen in the running game

rows.title: {greeting}
rows.body: Ralof's opening line from the player's Skyrim strings, then 'Choose who you are.'

rows.title: Choose your race
rows.body: one button per playable Skyrim race; tip = race description + skill bonuses

rows.title: {race} - Level {level} - Perk points: {points}
rows.body: 18 skill buttons grouped combat/stealth/magic; tip = Skyrim description, XP bar, Pandora effect

rows.title: same as u_skills
rows.body: the class skill tab opens the Skyrim skills menu

rows.title: {skill} {level} - Perk points: {points}
rows.body: one button per perk node, constellation order; tip = Skyrim perk text, rank, requirement, Pandora effect

rows.title: You have reached level {level}
rows.body: plus 'Perk point available' (open with the skills key)

rows.title: Word of Power learned: {word}
rows.body: the word and its translation from Skyrim

rows.title: {shout}
rows.body: 'ready' when the cooldown ends; remaining seconds when pressed too early

rows.title: Class skills are sealed
rows.body: points into class trees are refused; points into Skyrim perks come from Dragonborn levels

rows.title: Skyrim not found
rows.body: explains that the mashup reads Skyrim SE from the folder Melty passes, and that Skyrim features are off until it is found
